source: docs/2026-11-03-reading-cohort-policy.json (supersedes docs/2026-11-03-official-run-policy.json for demo selection; the earlier development runs keep their own records)
selection_rule: First started new-cohort attempt per case; preserve and count all failures and follow-ups, never silently substitute a later success
restored_caption: No mismatch in the tests Spark chose

structure_spotlight.eligible_if: first official attempt contains a genuine structure_proposed event selected_by muse_spark
structure_spotlight.if_neither: coverage_not_observed; do not manufacture or force proposal; do not substitute a later attempt

selection.followups: Keep all attempts, label separately, never replace the preselected first official run; include official attempts in attempt-level accounting

display_rule_2026_11_04.text: Each case's replay is the first official attempt that reached a diagnostic verdict with the board matching the registered fault wiring. Attempts stopped before a verdict, and attempts whose wiring differed from the registration (checked by photo), stay in the repository ledger and in the attempt counts but are not used as a case replay. This display rule was written down on 4 Nov, after results.
